title: Associate - Fund Accounting
description:
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka Team: Fund Accounting Job Requisition #: R266780 Date posted: Oct. 13, 2026

  

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

  
  

**Job Description**

The role requires a detailed technical understanding of Private Equity funds, and the specific intricacies required in preparing financial statements, computing carry, private equity equalization and late closing interest. The role also requires detailed knowledge, through direct working experience, of waterfalls, IRR and other performance metrics (e.g. MoiC, DPI, TERs). The successful candidate will have extensive experience in preparing periodic and annual audited GAAP based financial statements specifically for Private Equity funds.

**Responsibilities:**

* Prepare and review quarterly management accounts for client private equity funds.
* Lead general client reporting requirements, understanding the structure of the existing reports and client service level standards and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Compute carry, equalization and late closing interest for funds administered. Prepare and review waterfall calculations.
* Maintain and process accounting records through journals and other transactions to the general ledger and trial balance.
* Manage and coordinate annual fund audits with external auditors and the client.
* Review draft annual financial statements in accordance with IFRS, UK GAAP, US GAAP, Canadian GAAP and Lux GAAP depending on fund domicile.
* Liaise with the tax team to ensure timely completion of tax engagements and appropriate charges and accruals are recorded in the financial statements.
* Complete and review regulatory returns as and when required.
* Develop a clear understanding of cash management function of the funds.
* Work with and provide support to the treasury team as and when required including but not limited to review bank reconciliation, cash management reports, daily liquidity monitoring, invoice and payment releases
* Involvement in vital team management and allocation planning
* Training development and potential management of junior team members
* Involvement in RFPs for new prospects and successful onboarding of new clients

* Identify and implement process improvements to enhance operational efficiency, strengthen controls, and improve the quality and consistency of fund accounting and reporting activities.
* Drive the development and adoption of AI and automation solutions to streamline fund accounting, strengthen analysis and reconciliations, improve exception detection and reporting, and enhance review effectiveness with appropriate governance and oversight.

**Qualifications:**

* 4+ years of strong related experience in the private equity fund accounting is preferred

* An understanding of fund/group structures preferred but not essential
* Knowledge on private equity carry, waterfall, LCI and equalisation specific to private equity funds
* UK or US GAAP working knowledge is essential and IFRS, Canadian GAAP or Lux GAAP is desirable but not essential
* Experience with FIA (front invest analytics) ideal, but not required
* Excellent working knowledge of accounting databases/running reports
* Competent user of MS Excel and other MS products

* Experience in using AI and automation tools, including identifying use-case scenarios, prompt writing, output validation, and responsible data governance.

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Associate HRIS Analyst, Workday Operations
description:
Join our Global Workforce Systems team as an Associate HRIS Analyst, Workday Operations and quickly expand your Workday knowledge through hands-on experience. You will manage JIRA tickets, process routine Workday transactions, maintain accurate employee data, and support process documentation. We are looking for someone with one to two years of Workday experience who is curious, careful, and committed to delivering accurate results.  
  
This is a regular, full-time position based in Bangalore, India and requires a work schedule that provides coverage during core U.S. business hours.

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the first level of review and support for HRIS and Workday requests submitted through JIRA, ensuring requests are acknowledged, assessed, and appropriately routed.
* Support the day-to-day management of the JIRA ticket queue by reviewing new tickets, prioritizing routine requests according to established guidelines, monitoring aging items, updating statuses, and following up as needed.
* Evaluate incoming tickets for completeness, urgency, business impact, dependencies, and appropriate next steps.
* Resolve routine Workday questions, requests, transactions, and data issues using established procedures and documented solutions.
* Proactively request missing information or clarification when a ticket does not contain sufficient details to investigate or complete the request accurately.
* Escalate complex, high-risk, time-sensitive, or unresolved issues to the appropriate HRIS team member with clear documentation of the issue, troubleshooting performed, supporting information, and recommended next steps.
* Maintain complete and timely JIRA documentation, including the original request, investigation performed, actions taken, stakeholder communication, decisions, and final resolution.
* Monitor open tickets and dependencies and proactively follow up when information, approvals, testing, or action is outstanding.
* Identify tickets at risk of missing established service expectations or deadlines and escalate appropriately.
* Complete assigned routine Workday transactions and employee data updates across the employee lifecycle, according to established procedures, approval requirements, and role-based access.
* Review source documentation and validate key information, including employee names, dates, organizations, positions, statuses, and other relevant data, before completing Workday transactions.
* Perform post-transaction quality checks and follow documented validation steps to confirm that changes were processed accurately, escalating unexpected results or potential downstream impacts.
* Research employee and HRIS data discrepancies, reconcile information between source documentation and Workday, resolve routine issues, and escalate exceptions when necessary.
* Support Workday testing for system updates, enhancements, fixes, and configuration changes, including executing test scripts, validating expected results, documenting defects, and tracking issues through resolution.
* Assist with documenting and maintaining HRIS workflows and process maps, including process steps, responsibilities, handoffs, and escalation paths.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, process guides, job aids, user instructions, FAQs, and HRIS knowledge articles to improve consistency and reduce repeat questions.
* Review existing workflows and documentation periodically to ensure they remain accurate and aligned with current Workday functionality and business processes.
* Identify recurring tickets, data issues, bottlenecks, or manual processes and share observations and potential improvement opportunities with the HRIS team.
* Support routine data audits, reconciliations, and validation activities to maintain HRIS data integrity.
* Prepare, send, track, and validate manual HR notifications, ensuring communications are accurate, timely, and sent to the appropriate recipients.
* Partner collaboratively with Talent & Culture (HR), Payroll, Benefits, Talent Acquisition, Compensation, IT, and other stakeholders as necessary to investigate and resolve HRIS requests.
* Handle employee and organizational data in accordance with established privacy, confidentiality, and information-security requirements.

**What You Bring**

* 1–2 years of experience supporting Workday within HR, HRIS, People Operations, Shared Services, or a similar environment.
* Hands-on experience reviewing or processing employee data and transactions in Workday.
* Experience using JIRA or a comparable ticket/case-management platform, including reviewing, assigning, prioritizing, documenting, tracking, escalating, and resolving support requests.
* Demonstrated ability to manage a ticket queue independently, balance competing priorities, and follow requests through to resolution.
* Experience creating or maintaining workflows, process documentation, SOPs, job aids, or knowledge articles.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify missing, inconsistent, or potentially inaccurate information.
* A proactive approach to work, including the ability to identify outstanding actions, anticipate potential issues, and follow up without waiting for direction.
* Strong problem-solving and investigative skills with the judgment to distinguish between issues that can be resolved independently and those requiring escalation.
* Ability to follow detailed procedures while recognizing opportunities to improve existing processes.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple tickets, recurring responsibilities, and deadlines simultaneously.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document technical or process-related information in a way that is understandable to different audiences.
* Ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders across teams, locations, and time zones.
* Ability to appropriately handle confidential employee and organizational information.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**What Will Help You Succeed**

* Experience supporting Workday Core HCM and one or more related areas such as Recruiting, Benefits, Compensation, Talent, Absence, or other employee lifecycle functionality.
* Experience with JIRA-based HRIS support operations, including queue management, ticket prioritization, escalation, and reporting.
* Experience creating process maps and end-to-end workflow documentation.
* Experience conducting employee data audits, reconciliations, or validation activities.
* Familiarity with system-testing practices, including executing Workday test scripts, validating results, documenting defects, and supporting issue resolution.
* Ability to identify patterns across support tickets and recommend improvements through documentation, process changes, training, automation, or system enhancements.
* Demonstrated ownership and initiative: actively monitoring the queue, recognizing what needs attention, following up on stalled requests, surfacing risks, and communicating when escalation is required.
